source_snapshot.items: Updated firmware for all baseboard components will activate after AC power cycle
source_snapshot.procedure: Upload DGX bundle to Redfish HGX_0, wait task, AC cycle, check inventory.
source_snapshot.criteria: Flash succeeds and new version correct.

old_problem: All baseboard components are not mapped to HGX_0; bundle contents, versions, activation and rollback are unknown.
disposition_reason: ED-07 requires retained flash/version coverage and independent authorization; exact components/images/targets/recovery cannot be inferred from generic Redfish.
decision_basis: Preserved all-component task and AC activation coverage.
No flash or power action occurred.

test_case.purpose: Update every approved baseboard component, activate by authorized AC cycle and verify each active version/health.
required_package: Stable power, AC and rollback/OOB plan
test_case.test_command: Do not upload until mapped. Capture inventory; verify bundle/targets; submit one approved task; preserve status; separately authorize AC OFF-ON-OS-ready; verify every component version/health.
test_case.expected_result: All and only mapped components reach target active versions after AC activation with no error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Task complete or one HGX_0 version cannot prove all baseboard components.
test_case.recovery: Do not cycle after failed task; follow vendor rollback and preserve evidence.

source_conflict.reason: All components versus one unmapped HGX_0 target.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Map targets/banks, bundle versions, activation and rollback.
